name: keyline
title: Keyline
description: Keyline tokens and construction primitives: role weights, the optional cut (--kl-cut), cells, flood, lamp, unfold, dock, pending. Source tokens go to your :root and .dark; theme/tokens.ts holds them as data.

light.kl-font: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-yellow: oklch(from var(--kl-working) calc(l - 0.04 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * (1 - 0.06 * var(--kl-dark))) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-data-2: oklch(from var(--kl-cobalt) calc(l + 0.18 + 0.02 * var(--kl-dark)) calc(c * 0.5) h)
:root, .light, .dark, [data-kl-config].--kl-hatch:
repeating-linear-gradient(
      -45deg,
      transparent 0 5px,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--kl-ink) 14%, transparent) 5px 6px
    )

.kl-frame, .kl-ctl.clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-frame:is([dir=\"rtl\"], [dir=\"rtl\".clip-path:
polygon(
        calc(100% - var(--kl-c) - var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)),
        calc(-1 * var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(100% + var(--kl-o)),
        calc(100% + var(--kl-o)) calc(var(--kl-c) + var(--kl-o))
      )

.kl-flood:is( [data-kl-on], :not([data-k.transition:
background-color 0s linear var(--kl-t-flood),
      color 0s linear calc(var(--kl-t-flood) * 0.4)

docs: Shape: square by default (--kl-cut: 0). Set --kl-cut to 0.5 (quiet) or 1 (full) on :root or any subtree for the cut accent, or use data-kl-cut="quiet" | "on" | "off". Density: data-kl-density="compact". Reduced motion: honours prefers-reduced-motion; data-kl-motion="reduce" forces it.
